description: This is a Java test class for the AuthorRepository, containing unit tests for CRUD operations such as findAll, delete, and deleteAll, using Spring Data JPA and JUnit 5.

classes.name: AuthorRepositoryTest
classes.description: Test class for AuthorRepository, verifying CRUD operations and integration with Spring Data JPA.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by clearing the repository before each test.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Tests that the repository can retrieve all authors after saving multiple entries.
